title: Stats
description: GET /stats?metric=&since=[&cursor=] (feature stats). One metric per call: bucketed points (each the complete total for one calendar day in the manifest's stats_zone, equal keys replace), the windows the add-on could not observe, and a watermark through which the metric is final.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 2: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

taken_at.description: When the add-on's collector last read the app.

watermark.description: The instant through which this metric is final, including absence: a midnight in the manifest's stats_zone, never later than the start of taken_at's day.

start.description: A midnight in the manifest's stats_zone (RFC 3339 with its offset).

end.description: The next midnight in stats_zone (start + P1D on the calendar).

subject.description: The Syndra subject id, never a local name; absent for a total.

unbound.description: How many accounts Syndra does not manage contributed to the totals.

start.description: A midnight in the manifest's stats_zone.

end.description: End of the unobserved window, a later midnight in stats_zone.

next_cursor.description: A keyset cursor; null on the last page.
